title: Interface addressing
text: FRRouting interface configuration uses an interface NAME context. Inside that context, ip address ADDRESS/PREFIX assigns an IPv4 address. This prototype closes the context with exit before adding global static routes. Use an interface host address and retain the prefix length.

title: Static route destination and gateway
text: A basic FRRouting IPv4 static route has the form ip route NETWORK GATEWAY. NETWORK is a destination prefix. GATEWAY is a next-hop address. For this project's IPv4-only subset, give the gateway as an IPv4 address without a CIDR suffix. Additional FRRouting route forms exist but are outside this prototype.

title: VerifyNet template contract
text: VerifyNet supports explicit profiles for IPv4, multi-route IPv4, IPv6, VLAN 802.1Q, OSPF, Cisco IOS, and Juniper Junos. Each profile has a bounded variable contract and vendor or protocol-specific command checks. Templates must use placeholders rather than hardcoded examples; the checker renders alternate parameter sets, requires agreement with the explicit intent, rejects unsafe or extra commands, and records virtual-router evidence when Docker tests are available. A local pass is evidence for the tested contract, not a production-device guarantee.
